reasoning: The evidence strongly suggests LLM hallucinations will NOT be 'fixed' by end of 2025. A September 2024 peer-reviewed paper mathematically proves hallucinations are inherent to LLMs using Gödel's incompleteness theorem, with a theoretical 4% residual floor even with best mitigation. Recent 2025 research confirms hallucination rates of 2.5-15% across models, up to 69-88% in specialized domains.
